description: Avoid function calls in dataclass field defaults; the call runs once at class definition, so every instance shares its result.

flake8-bugbear.extend-immutable-calls.description: Qualified names of further calls that return immutable values.

violation.message: Pass the callable as `field(default_factory=...)`, using a lambda if it takes arguments, or assign the result to a module-level constant if sharing it is intended; leave immutable results.
Pass the callable as `attrs.field(factory=...)`, using a lambda if it takes arguments, or assign the result to a module-level constant if sharing it is intended; leave immutable results.
